column1: # The corpus states whose own record (the one made for no stated depth/stencil test class) has no storage form.
# Since 7f02e9020 a state that fetches beside a depth or stencil attachment draws through its tests=1..4 variant
# records (directpack.mm testClasses, TegraGM20BMetalCubic.mm drawnTests), so a row draws a triangle at a time
# (fetch_order.h) only where its why says so. Every 24B119 state of the earlier list is a storage form in the
# 24B119 pack built 18 Nov 01:12 (format 43 through its R16_UINT view, the depth-exporting and 4x sRGB states
# through their variants); the 21H461 rows wait for a 21H461 pack (out/agent-scratch/c38-audit/storage-forms/
# packrecs.py lists a pack's records for these hashes). hash is the state's pipeline key hash.
